title: Independent verification: all eight K492 emitter controls (no new bound)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Add `research/k492-emitter-independent-controls/`, an independent reconstruction of all eight `emit.*` source-site controls in `PROOF-NOTE-R.md` on the historical #626/R492 fixture. The standard-library checker reconstructs helper-frame ranks, complete ownership, interval partitions, private storage geometry, retained controller expansion and source bindings. It adds 18 adversarial semantic corruptions with refreshed output hashes and two positive controls.

The scientific inputs remain pinned to `66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60`; all 24 pinned inputs are byte-identical at integration base `ce7ad1b6ab09452c3478723a2e96ed5ff212dc08`. #626 is a historical checkpoint. This contribution changes no construction, selected result, mathematical hypothesis or multiplication bound.

Prior work: #766 covers all 14 assembly source sites and explicitly excludes the emitter slice; #724 supplies invoice/assembly accounting and already explains the conceptual R/R0 distinction. #675 covers owner-window and bridge evidence; #780 independently checks owner footprints using interval endpoints, while #727 optimizes occupancy checks with bitmasks. Neither the R/R0 distinction nor the interval technique is claimed as a new discovery here. Existing construction and supplier attributions are retained in the package README.

#819 supplies related gzip-portable native-owner binding; gzip-insensitive comparisons are not claimed as a new technique. A publication refresh screened 767 open and 383 closed PR titles/bodies plus the exact emitter-site names in current main; no equivalent eight-emitter suite was identified within that non-atomic snapshot. `OVERLAP.md` records the precise overlap boundaries and screening limits.

Scope limits: this does not recover the unavailable original 32-site scratch suite or `GlobalR/run504b`, execute the other 24 source sites, rebuild the native providers, or independently re-prove scalar/Clifford/phase identities, owner-window feasibility, invoice/assembly inequalities, all-size compilation, physical hosting, precision/tape or analytic transfer. It is finite implementation evidence, not a full multiplication-theorem proof.

Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex / GPT-6 Astra assistance, including a separate Astra code review and rerun. No human peer review is claimed. New files follow the repository's Apache-2.0 license.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -B research/k492-emitter-independent-controls/run.py --out /tmp/k492-emitter-publication-review-20261013
```

Fresh run on 2026-10-13: exit 0, `PASS_COMPLETE_EIGHT_EMITTER_SITE_SLICE` (CPython 3.13.2, 38.96 seconds).

- The full baseline `HOSTED.json` equals the retained #626 receipt exactly.
- Eight source controls: five fail at their required emitter line/exception class, two emit artifacts rejected by the independent checker, and the cosmetic-label control passes.
- Eighteen semantic corruptions are rejected after hash refresh; cosmetic-label and actual gzip-recompression positive controls pass.
- Recount: 984 helper-frame pairs, 35,424 roles, 7,670 physical rows, 7,672 sigma charts and 596,848 exact Gram entries.
- Fresh `BASELINE.json`, `RESULT.json`, `SEMANTIC-CONTROLS.json` and `INPUT-PINS.json` match the retained receipts byte-for-byte. All non-command source-control fields match. All 24 input pins also match committed blobs at the integration base.

`README.md`, `REVIEW.md` and machine-readable receipts document the contract and limitations. `PUBLICATION.md` and `evidence/PUBLICATION-NORMALIZATION.json` document replacement of personal checkout prefixes in 20 provenance fields across 12 receipts. Original source/hash values and mathematical evidence are preserved; `MANIFEST.json` identifies the publication bytes. Broad construction tests and a new cold provider rebuild were not run because the change is confined to this independent finite-check package.
